title: Off-Task Action Detector Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents

original_idea.body: # Off-Task Action Detector Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: off-task detection is a runtime safeguard, but link to catastrophic AI risk is somewhat indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: curate labeled set + benchmark cheap detectors; annotation is some manual work.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (labeled set + detector precision/recall), dataset curation adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: public trajectories + API/embedding calls, reusable infrastructure.

low_compute.reasoning: API/embedding calls only, no local GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Off-task detection studied; a labeled detector benchmark may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A small labeled off-task detector benchmark likely missing.
